                     INTRODUCTION TO CLASSROOM MANAGEMENT

Topic- 001

An Introduction

Classroom management is a very important part of the professional development of ECE teachers.
A teacher’s duty is not only to teach the class but also to handle the management issues in the
classroom for effective teaching and learning process.

Educators, researchers, and policymakers recognize that highly-quality early childhood education
prepares young children for long-term social-emotional and academic success. The most critical
aspect of childhood education is classroom management. Moreover, teachers' behavior plays a vital
role in getting young children to school readiness. The benefits of a good classroom environment
are as follows:

    Promotes positive behavior

    Self-regulation

    Social competence and children show a high level of task engagement (Thompson, 2002)

Reference: Emmer, E. T., & Sabornie, E. J. (Eds.). (2015). Handbook of classroom
management.NewYork:Routledge.

In this lecture, the following topics of classroom management are discussed:

    -   Elements of classroom management
    -   Classroom management approaches and strategies
    -   Models of classroom management
    -   ECE Teacher’s role in classroom management
    -   Classroom management and the curriculum
    -   Discipline
    -   Bullying and social-emotional learning

    -   It is very important to have discipline in the classroom to have good teaching and learning.
        Without good discipline, good teaching and good learning are not possible. Sometimes
        Lesson planning is very good but due to discipline issues, the teaching-learning process
        cannot be successful.
        The other main part of classroom management is Bullying. Bullying is a problem of overall
        in school. Children bully each other within the classroom and outside the classroom. Such
        children lack elements of social-emotional learning. They lack social and emotional learning
        and because of that, they bully other children. So, when they bully other children effective
        teaching and learning cannot takes place. So, it is necessary for ECE teachers to prevent
        bullying within the classrooms as well as in school
        There are many ways of bullying. It could be permanent or temporary. So, it is necessary for

        Moreover, it is essential to emphasize the social-emotional learning of students. Classroom
        management and social-emotional learning go together. If you have good social-emotional

Topic – 002

Definition of Classroom Management:

There are two specific aspects of early childhood environments:
    1- Teacher-child relationships
    2- The physical environment arrangement of the classrooms.
 A critical aspect of the classroom is the quality of the relationship between the teacher and the
children. When a teacher demonstrates kindness and respect toward children through the use of
affectionate words or appropriate physical contact, young children similarly behave towards peers
and adults in the classroom. Moreover, the arrangement and structure of the early childhood

Classroom management embodies:

    -     Effective teaching of content (Content knowledge is very important. Classroom
          management problems arise because an ECE teacher is sometimes not sure of what he/she
          is teaching)
    -     Powerful teaching strategies (It is extremely important to use effective teaching strategies so
          that less classroom management problems arise. Sometimes, the problems in classroom arise
          because ECE teachers do not know the teaching strategies)
    -     An organizational structure to support productive learning (the seating arrangement of the
          classroom, are students sitting in rows or groups?)
    -     Effective use of social-emotional domains of learning
    -     The most successful ECE teachers approach management as a process of establishing and
          maintaining effective learning environments.
          Classroom management is a very broad domain. It starts with the ECE teacher’s own
          personality. It starts with the kind of knowledge a teacher has and the way that knowledge is
          given to the students. Knowledge comes foremost. Knowledge is very important together
          with pedagogical strategies in classroom management.
